configControls.name: nonHarborSessionLimit
configControls.purpose: Set how many non-Harbor sessions may run concurrently on a host with a CPU budget. Defaults to one.

configControls.name: idleWorkMinutes
configControls.purpose: Set how long an unassigned Tracker task can remain idle during Lisbon daytime before the hub requests pickup. Defaults to 120 minutes.

configControls.name: additionalAuthors
configControls.purpose: Add verified GitHub tester logins for urgent issues and comment follow-up.
